south-kaibab-ooh-aah.note: Grand Canyon National Park's Key Hiking Messages page, last updated October 27, 2026 and rechecked directly today with no newer update found, states South Kaibab Trail is open from the South Kaibab Trailhead to Black Bridge, which covers Ooh Aah Point and Cedar Ridge well within the open section (Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park). Black Bridge and Silver Bridge, which span the Colorado River, remain closed due to hazardous conditions from flash flooding, so through-hikes to Phantom Ranch or the North Rim are not possible, but South Kaibab Trail itself is open for day hikes to Ooh Aah Point and beyond, with no estimated reopening of the bridge closures at this time. Potable water is available at the South Kaibab Trailhead tank; there is no reliable water source below the trailhead. This trail is fully sun exposed. bright-angel-indian-garden.note: Grand Canyon National Park's Key Hiking Messages page, last updated October 27, 2026 and rechecked directly today with no newer update found, states Bright Angel Trail is open from the Bright Angel Trailhead to the River Resthouse, which covers Havasupai Gardens (formerly Indian Garden) well within the open section (Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park). Beyond River Resthouse, Black Bridge and Silver Bridge remain closed due to hazardous conditions from flash flooding, with no estimated reopening at this time, so Phantom Ranch and the river crossing remain inaccessible.
